verdict.rationale: The docs say every flow starts with a trigger that activates its actions, and Activepieces connects 760+ apps as an open-source Zapier replacement, so event-driven flows are its core model. However, nothing in the pack explicitly shows triggers firing on connected-app events such as new records, messages, emails or form submissions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of app-event triggers (new record, new message, new email, form submission), a list or examples of trigger types per app, independent or hands-on corroboration of event triggering.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
Move data, send messages and update records between 764 apps without writing glue code.
An open source replacement for Zapier
